scripts.api:generate:source: openapi-generator-cli generate -i contracts/openapi.json -g dart-dio -o packages/wenyou_api -c tool/openapi-generator-config.yaml --global-property apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelTests=false
scripts.api:generate: npm run api:generate:source && npm run api:normalize && cd packages/wenyou_api && dart pub get && dart run build_runner build && cd ../.. && flutter pub get
scripts.api:check: npm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/wenyou_api
